new_entities.name: StressTestExercise
new_entities.description: A PRA annual concurrent stress test exercise. Tracks the lifecycle from scenario loading through to PRA submission. Owned by SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) as the system that runs the projections and owns the model outputs.

fields.name: exercise_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this stress test exercise

fields.name: exercise_year
fields.description: Calendar year of the PRA stress test (e.g. 2026)

fields.name: pra_scenario_version
fields.description: PRA scenario reference (e.g. 'ACS-2026-v1.0')

fields.name: scenario_type
fields.description: severe_adverse | adverse | baseline

fields.name: status
fields.description: pending | in_progress | projections_complete | approved_for_submission | submitted | closed

fields.name: triggered_by
fields.description: FK to PER-059 (CRO) who initiated the exercise

fields.name: scenarios_loaded_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when PRA scenarios were loaded

fields.name: projections_completed_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when all model projections completed

fields.name: board_approved_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp of Board Risk Committee sign-off

fields.name: cro_attestation_ref
fields.description: CRO attestation reference for submission sign-off

fields.name: pra_submission_ref
fields.description: PRA confirmation reference number from BEEDS portal

fields.name: submitted_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp of PRA submission

fields.name: pra_deadline
fields.description: PRA submission deadline date

fields.name: projected_stressed_cet1_y1
fields.description: Projected CET1 ratio Year 1 under severe adverse scenario (%)

fields.name: projected_stressed_cet1_y2
fields.description: Projected CET1 ratio Year 2 under severe adverse scenario (%)

fields.name: projected_stressed_cet1_y3
fields.description: Projected CET1 ratio Year 3 under severe adverse scenario (%)

fields.name: model_validation_sign_off_ref
fields.description: Model validation sign-off reference per SS1/23

design_decisions: StressTestExercise owned by SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) — risk projections are the core output and SVC-012 executes the models.

Projected CET1 ratios stored on StressTestExercise for the severe adverse scenario (the regulatory binding scenario). Full scenario outputs are stored in the model output data store, referenced by exercise_id.

new_entities.name: RegulatorySubmission
new_entities.description: A regulatory submission record tracking submissions to the PRA, FCA, or other regulatory authorities. Owned by SVC-015 (Compliance Core, CAP-005). The stress test PRA submission is one instance of this entity. Other submissions (e.g. ICAAP, regulatory returns) reuse the same entity.

fields.name: submission_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this regulatory submission

fields.name: submission_type
fields.description: pra_stress_test | icaap | fca_rmar | other

fields.name: exercise_id
fields.description: FK to StressTestExercise (if submission_type = pra_stress_test)

fields.name: regulatory_body
fields.description: PRA | FCA | BoE | HMRC

fields.name: submission_ref
fields.description: Confirmation reference from regulatory portal

fields.name: deadline_date
fields.description: Regulatory submission deadline

fields.name: submitted_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp of confirmed submission

fields.name: status
fields.description: pending | submitted | confirmed | late

fields.name: submitted_by
fields.description: FK to PER-059 who made the submission

relationships.description: RegulatorySubmission references StressTestExercise for stress test submissions

design_decisions: RegulatorySubmission is a general-purpose entity owned by SVC-015 to capture all regulatory submissions. Stress test submission is one instance.
This entity will be reused by future journeys (ICAAP, Pillar 3, RMAR) avoiding fragmentation of regulatory submission tracking.
